Office roles use their own display name and email, without linking a faculty record. Existing administrative accounts keep their current UID.

Access roles: Owner controls User Management. Administrator manages faculty and timetable workflows. Other Office sees only its own Change History. ADC manages scheduling fields; LAB manages LAB topics. Neither role has Faculty Dashboard access. HICC, VISC and Faculty are faculty-facing roles.

Select a faculty record to load the profile identity.
To link an existing Authentication login, verify its UID and email in Firebase Console, then enter the UID here. No second login is created. Leave UID blank only to create a new login with a temporary password.
